title: Spikers' Turf: Ocay, 3B take down AFP for breakthrough win
summary: 3B secured its first win of the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday, fending off the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), 25-18, 25-12, 23-25, 25-21, at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
